# analysis target=nvidia.b200_sxm module=Operators function=add_norm_fp8_linear topology=cta
# selection requested=compute-cost,memory,roofline executed=compute-cost,memory,roofline
# compute-cost flops=bf16:20992@logical,20992@total,20992@cta;f32:8007842@logical,8007842@total,8007842@cta;fp8e4m3:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta other-ops=special:2@logical,2@total,2@cta
# traffic traffic=gmem:r23012952/w21559256@total,r23012952/w21559256@cta;rmem:r8/w0@total,r8/w0@cta
# peak-footprint=gmem:11971200;rmem:0
# roofline ideal-ns=5810 bound-by=memory

from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403

@func
def add_norm_fp8_linear(
    x: Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"],
    residual: Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"],
    gamma: Tensor[(5120,), "f32"],
    weight: Tensor[(256, 5120), "fp8e4m3"],
    weight_scale: Tensor[(2, 40), "f32"]
):
    v0 = cast(x, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v1 = cast(residual, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v2 = add(v0, v1)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r81920/w40960@total,r81920/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=17 bound-by=memory
    v3 = cast(v2, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w20480@total,r40960/w20480@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v4 = cast(v3, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v5 = unary(v4, kind="square")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w40960@total,r40960/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v6 = reduce(v5, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="mean")  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w8@total,r40960/w8@cta; roofline ideal-ns=6 bound-by=memory
    v0_2 = 1e-06  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v7 = add(v6, v0_2)  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:2@logical,2@total,2@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r8/w8@total,r8/w8@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v8 = unary(v7, kind="rsqrt")  # Tensor[(2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost other-ops=special:2@logical,2@total,2@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r8/w8@total,r8/w8@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=memory
    v9 = mul(v4, v8)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40968/w40960@total,r40968/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v10 = mul(v9, gamma)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r61440/w40960@total,r61440/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=14 bound-by=memory
    v11 = cast(v10, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w20480@total,r40960/w20480@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v12 = tuple_get_item((v3, v11), index=0)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v13 = tuple_get_item((v3, v11), index=1)  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v14 = cast(v13, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r20480/w40960@total,r20480/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v15 = reshape(v14, new_shape=(2, 40, 128))  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v16 = reduce(v15, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="abs_max")  # Tensor[(2, 40, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w320@total,r40960/w320@cta; roofline ideal-ns=6 bound-by=memory
    v17 = clamp(v16, min_val=1e-10, max_val=1e999)  # Tensor[(2, 40, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:80@logical,80@total,80@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r320/w320@total,r320/w320@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v2_2 = 448.0  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v18 = div(v17, v2_2)  # Tensor[(2, 40, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:80@logical,80@total,80@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r320/w320@total,r320/w320@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v19 = div(v15, v18)  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r41280/w40960@total,r41280/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v20 = clamp(v19, min_val=-448.0, max_val=448.0)  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w40960@total,r40960/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v21 = cast(v20, dtype="fp8e4m3")  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost flops=fp8e4m3:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w10240@total,r40960/w10240@cta; roofline ideal-ns=7 bound-by=memory
    v22 = cast(v21, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r10240/w40960@total,r10240/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=7 bound-by=memory
    v23 = mul(v22, v18)  # Tensor[(2, 40, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:10240@logical,10240@total,10240@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r41280/w40960@total,r41280/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=11 bound-by=memory
    v24 = reshape(v23, new_shape=(2, 5120))  # Tensor[(2, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v25 = cast(weight, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(256, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:1310720@logical,1310720@total,1310720@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1310720/w5242880@total,r1310720/w5242880@cta; roofline ideal-ns=855 bound-by=memory
    v26 = repeat_interleave(weight_scale, repeats=128, axis=0)  # Tensor[(256, 40), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r320/w40960@total,r320/w40960@cta; roofline ideal-ns=6 bound-by=memory
    v27 = repeat_interleave(v26, repeats=128, axis=1)  # Tensor[(256, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r40960/w5242880@total,r40960/w5242880@cta; roofline ideal-ns=689 bound-by=memory
    v28 = mul(v25, v27)  # Tensor[(256, 5120), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:1310720@logical,1310720@total,1310720@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r10485760/w5242880@total,r10485760/w5242880@cta; roofline ideal-ns=2051 bound-by=memory
    v29 = transpose(v28, perm=(1, 0))  # Tensor[(5120, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r5242880/w5242880@total,r5242880/w5242880@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1367 bound-by=memory
    v30 = matmul(v24, v29, a_layout="MK", b_layout="KN")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:5242880@logical,5242880@total,5242880@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r5283840/w2048@total,r5283840/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=689 bound-by=memory
    v31 = cast(v30, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w1024@total,r2048/w1024@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    return (v12, v31)
